source.title: Atlas of the World Battle Fronts in Semimonthly Phases to August 15, 1945
source.publisher: United States War Department, General Staff (supplement to the Biennial Report of the Chief of Staff, 1 July 1943 – 30 June 1945); public domain
corrections: Breslau: Festung Breslau, encircled on 15 February and held until 6 May 1945 (encircled by Soviet units on the OKH map Lage Ost of the end of March 1945) (https://wwii.germandocsinrussia.org/de/nodes/23825)
Kolberg: The Pomeranian coast east of the Dievenow, Soviet since March 1945 (the atlas outline runs just inland of it) (https://wwii.germandocsinrussia.org/de/nodes/23825)

Left bank of the Rhine: The left bank of the Rhine from Wesel to Koblenz, taken in Operations Veritable, Grenade and Lumberjack (Cologne 6 March 1945); the Ruhr pocket lies east of the river (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Lumberjack)
